# infrawrench_jira_integration (Resource)

The organization's Jira Cloud connection, used to file issues from findings and alerts.

An organization **singleton** — one connection per organization. `terraform destroy` disconnects it, which drops the stored token; existing issue links survive.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `account_email` (String) Atlassian account email — the username half of the basic-auth pair.
- `site_url` (String) Jira Cloud site address, e.g. `https://acme.atlassian.net`. Must resolve to an `.atlassian.net` (or legacy `.jira.com`) host; a bare hostname and a pasted board or issue URL are both accepted and normalized — which can produce a one-time diff after the first apply if you wrote something other than the canonical form.

### Optional

- `api_token` (String, Sensitive) API token from id.atlassian.com. **Required on first connect**; omit it afterwards to keep the stored token, which is what lets you change the default project without having the credential to hand.

Write-only: no route returns it, so the provider cannot detect drift on its value. Compare `token_hint` if you need to check which token is stored.
- `default_issue_type_id` (String) Issue type the file-issue window preselects. A numeric Jira issue-type id, not a name.
- `default_project_key` (String) Project the file-issue window preselects, e.g. `OPS`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The organization id. The Jira connection is an organization singleton, so this is the only value it ever takes and it is what `terraform import` addresses.
- `token_hint` (String) Redacted marker for the stored token, e.g. `…a7f2`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# An organization singleton: there is only ever one, and it has no id of its
# own, so it imports under the organization id.
terraform import infrawrench_jira_integration.this org_01HXYZABCDEF
```
